text: Sophie is characterized primarily by her brilliance as a scientist and her profound altruism. Her motivation is deeply personal, driven by a desire to cure a deadly disease that affected her during her youth. This personal history fuels her tireless dedication to her work, even when she faces significant obstacles such as professional skepticism and her own health setbacks. Her development is defined by resilience; rather than being defeated by these challenges, she maintains hope and determination, showcasing a strong capacity to persevere in the face of overwhelming odds.
